testcase.name: the identity window admits `limit` requests, refuses the next with a retry-after, and reopens after the window
the address window applies across identities when the transport supplies the hashed address
memory stays bounded: subjects beyond maxTrackedSubjects are swept, oldest first; defaults and invalid limits
every membership role against every tenant command: the decision equals the COMMAND_ROLE_MEMBERS table; OWNER passes everything; every denial names ROLE_INSUFFICIENT and the policy version
identity is not permission: a disabled or unverified identity is denied before any membership is read; CreateAgency needs no membership

scope: a caller without a live membership in the selected agency gets NOT_FOUND (foreign and nonexistent alike); a SUSPENDED member is NOT_AUTHORIZED / MEMBERSHIP_SUSPENDED; an INVITED one MEMBERSHIP_NOT_ACTIVE; a REVOKED one NOT_FOUND
no cached grant: a SUSPENDED member reactivated in the store is allowed on the next decision, and a revoked one is refused on the next decision
step-up (CMD025): a fresh proof of the actor allows with assurance class STEP_UP; missing, foreign, expired or stale proofs are ASSURANCE_REQUIRED with the exact reason
commands whose role is not a membership (corporate, service) are denied by default

R16: the stored identity row is consulted beside the token — a DISABLED row refuses a token that says ACTIVE, for a member and for CreateAgency; a stored row never verifies a token that is not, and no stored row leaves the token's facts to decide

access and assurance are two decisions (R7): access never reads a proof — the replay of a step-up command is answered to a current member whose proof has aged; assurance is step 8 of a new execution only; a unit of work bound to another person decides nothing
